cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Talk Around the Mess
cards.instruction: Keep attention on minor details so no one addresses the larger responsibility you avoided.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Mum's coming for lunch. Is this spoon clean enough for her?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The spoon's fine. You haven't cleaned the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. She checks cutlery. Could you check the forks while I finish this?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've told her to bring rubber gloves and help you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we need a guest towel. Can you help me choose one without a faded stripe?

mechanism: A turns an avoided kitchen-cleaning duty into lessons on tiny presentation details to keep B from discussing the real unfinished work.
confusable: Not ordinary fussiness: B explicitly names the neglected responsibility and every correction steers away from it.
comparison: Guest cutlery/towel details versus box labels during an uncompleted move.
seedUse: Use D38 spoon/forks/Mum gloves/towel; S05 meticulous hosting lessons make B practical attempts serve the distraction.
